verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI page lists delegable tasks: swapping light and dark components, generating palettes from photos, sorting and renaming layers, and replacing placeholder text. However, these run through a built-in local MCP server that you connect to an external AI client such as ChatGPT or Claude, not through a native assistant inside the app. Missing for 10: a native in-app AI assistant that needs no third-party client, detailed docs on the in-product delegation workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these AI tasks work.
